scripts.setup: npm install && (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd backend && npm install)
scripts.format: docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm frontend npm run format && docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm backend npm run format
scripts.check: docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm frontend npm run check && docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm backend npm run check
